call.hello.hello_again.note: AI check: 'Kuuluuko minua?' (can you hear me?) instead of 'Hi?'; same choice as the earlier batches.

call.speech.no_thanks.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'Ei kiitos, ei kiinnosta' adds 'not interested'; the English is only 'Oh, no thanks'. Meaning should be: a mild polite no, e.g. 'Ai, ei kiitos.'

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I need to think about it a little.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Hey, wait, I still have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'Ai niin, yksi kysymys vielä' means 'Oh right, one more question' and lost 'wait'. This line stops the caller from hanging up, so it should mean 'Oh, wait, I have one more question', e.g. 'Hei odota, mulla on vielä yksi kysymys.'

call.speech.no_wait.back: «one moment», «wait a moment», «wait a moment» (plural/polite), «wait up», «let me check», «I'll check», «let's see», «I'll find out»
call.speech.no_wait.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: only 'odota hetki', 'odotapas' and 'hetkinen/hetki vain' plus 'tarkista' forms are listed: 'let me see / I'll have a look' ('katsotaanpa', 'katson'), 'I'll find out' ('selvitän') and the plural/polite 'odottakaa hetki' are missing, so the AI could say them unchecked. Meaning should be: banned stalling phrases for a friend and a stranger; add «odottakaa hetki», «katsotaanpa», «selvitän».

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you called cannot be reached right now. Try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Oh, a package? Yeah, you can leave it in front of the door, thanks a lot. / Alright, thanks, bye bye.
call.speech.preview.note: AI check: last line adds 'kiitos' (thanks) to 'Okay, bye'; harmless.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: bye bye, bye bye (casual), goodbye (formal, "until we hear"), goodbye (formal, "until we see"), bye, have a nice rest of the day, let's call each other, let's catch up. Wrap-ups: I have nothing else, nothing else this time, I have to go now, we'll talk more later, thanks for calling, I'll call you later. Ends: Thanks for the info, see you tomorrow, bye bye. / Alright, nothing else this time, have a nice rest of the day. / No thanks, I'm not interested, bye bye. Not ends: The neighbor just shouted bye bye, but go on, I'm listening. / Don't say bye bye yet, I have one question about the bill. / The program is called Goodbye and it costs a hundred euros a month.
call.speech.closing.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'moikka' is both a greeting and a goodbye in Finnish, so a caller who opens with 'Moikka!' could be read as ending the call; the translator already left out 'kuullaan' for the same reason. Meaning should be: only real goodbyes in farewells, so remove 'moikka' (the other eight are real goodbyes; not_ends and ends examples are fine). | Translator note: 'kuullaan' (talk soon) left out on purpose: it also means 'we hear', too risky. Kept ones are real goodbyes.

app.about_dedicated.back: In AI mode the module takes the phone app under its control, mutes the ringtone and switches Do Not Disturb on, so a spare phone suits best. If you want to use the phone normally for a moment, turn off the switch at the top.

app.about_legal.back: Different laws in different places apply to recording calls and to telling callers that they are talking with an AI. Following them is your responsibility.

app.about_rollback.back: If you want to remove Bageo completely, first turn off the switch at the top (back to a normal phone), then disable or uninstall the module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.

console.err_invalid_contact.back: Give a name and at least one phone number.

console.err_too_many_contacts.back: At most 10,000 contacts can be saved.

console.err_contacts_save_failed.back: The contacts could not be written to the disk.

console.err_need_gemini_key.back: Gemini reads this kind of file: first add the Gemini API key in the settings.

console.err_unsupported_file.back: This kind of file cannot be read. Save it as .xlsx, .csv, .vcf or PDF and try again.

console.err_file_too_large.back: The file is bigger than 10 MB.

console.err_ai_failed.back: Gemini was not able to read the file.

console.err_too_many_rows.back: The file is too large (at most 100,000 rows). Split it into parts or keep only the contact columns.

console.err_import_failed.back: Reading the file was interrupted. Try again.

console.s_meta.back: Changes take effect from the next call.

console.saved.back: Saved. Effective from the next call.

console.notify_follows_ui.back: Notifications are now also in the language {lang} (settings: Notification language).

console.g_basics_d.back: A few things the AI needs before it can answer your phone.

console.f_language_h.back: The language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language the AI speaks to callers.

console.f_simlang.back: Main language for each SIM card

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only for a phone that has a SIM from another country: calls to that SIM card start in the language chosen here. Requires app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_empty.back: Not set: every call starts in the language chosen above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers use for you. The AI uses it when it talks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names callers use for you

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English-language name, a nickname and so on. One per line, at most 10. The AI knows they mean you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without agreeing to anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key from Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI talks with. You rarely need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three example sentences in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are answered and ended immediately. If you want the phone to ring normally, choose "Switch to a normal phone" on the System page or in the app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings for a moment before answering, as a person would. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max.back: Maximum length of a normal call

console.f_normal_max_h.back: 3–30. A moment before the time limit the AI ends the conversation politely and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Prepare the AI while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks right when it answers. Off: the caller waits 1–3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: those calling without caller ID get the AI like everyone else. Off: they hear a short "not reachable" announcement and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops and listens when the caller talks over it. Not all phones can do this; Bageo checks it by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller has stopped

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_h.back: A message about the current situation, such as where a courier can leave a package. The AI mentions it only if it relates to the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: leave the package at the reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a quiet ambient sound behind the AI's voice so that it sounds like a real person.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or trying to scam.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends to be interested and asks about details in order to waste the caller's time. It gives out no information and does not agree to anything. Off: it refuses and ends the call.

console.f_stall_max.back: Maximum length of such a call

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3–30. Longer calls use up more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = same model as in normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI sound like you. All are optional.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in prompt is used

console.f_prompt_h.back: When filled in, it replaces the speaking style and local customs. Both answer styles keep their own; write {owner} where your name goes.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answer style and name. Save first if you just changed them.

console.p_replace_body.back: The editor already contains text. It will be replaced with the built-in prompt.

console.f_knowledge.back: Information the AI can answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back: e.g. Parcels: leave at the reception. Opening hours: Mon–Fri 9–18.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Things callers may ask about, one per line. The AI must not invent anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from a blacklisted or hidden number is rejected. Manage the blacklist under "Contacts".

console.b_help.back: End a number with the * character to block all numbers that begin the same way, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits excluding leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: Reject while ringing (the call does not connect)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play "not reachable", and end the call

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is spoken in the language chosen above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Receive a message when a call comes in and a summary when it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent to any channel.

console.n_empty.back: No channels yet. Add a channel to get the call summaries to your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check calls, ask the AI to call, and take care of tasks straight from this chat. Send /help to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message you can leave this empty. You get your own ID by asking @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First enable "Accept commands from this chat" in one of the channels above.

console.rc_env.back: Accept commands in the Telegram chat that is set with environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat of the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID variables. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS limits who may give commands.

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI calls from chats. At most 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: After this, the chat is not answered for the rest of the minute.

console.mcp_title.back: Allow other AI tools to connect (MCP)

console.mcp_desc.back: Allows AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to look at your calls and things to take care of. Leave it off if you do not need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when this is on and the Token below has been set. The address is the console's address plus /mcp.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token into the AI tool (in Bearer form).

console.mcp_calls.back: May it ask the AI to call?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me first in a chat

console.mcp_calls_h.back: "Ask me first" requires a chat that accepts commands.

console.mcp_errands.back: At most this many AI calls per hour

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that work in the browser: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with the @BotFather bot and paste its Token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you your own; for a group use the group's ID and add the bot to the group. Send the bot a message once so that it may write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in a Webhook address (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy webhook URL) or the bot's Token and the channel ID; one of them is enough. For a private message, put your own ID in place of the channel ID. Chat commands: fill in the bot's Token and the channel ID and enable Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook address (also Mattermost) or fill in the bot's Token and the channel ID; one of them is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): enable Socket Mode and then fill in the bot's Token (xoxb-), the app-level Token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: create a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with the letter U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify was closed in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty to use the ntfy.sh service. The Token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application and copy its Token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the example URL. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get the API Token. Your user key is in Pushover's dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose "Sign" as the protection, paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot and copy the webhook URL. Do not enable signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy the SendKey from the ServerChan site.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your home server (e.g. https://matrix.org), the access token of the sending account, and the ID of a room the account has joined (starts with the ! character).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google account → Security → 2-step verification → App passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which services get the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that receives a JSON POST request with the fields event, title, body and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → "Post in a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the URL you get. The old Office 365 connectors have been disabled.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook and copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: enable it, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and give its email and API key in the form email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone) or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and give the room ID, or a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, your user name and app password (Settings → Security) in the form user:password, and the conversation's Token: the last part of the conversation link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming webhooks → Create and copy the webhook URL. On your own network, the http:// address of port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server and a registered number. Give the server's address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to send to all your devices, or give a device ID or an email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your Token. A group code sends to the group; empty sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Easiest: a simple push Token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher site without a target. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) and user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a Token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any TLS mail server: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login name also acts as the sender. Use an app password if your service offers one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access Token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (shown under Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create the applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the heading and value2 the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: The links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in grey; with Docker or when used from outside your home, write your own.

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call the AI writes a short summary. Usually nothing needs adjusting here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses your Gemini key by default. If you want to use another service, choose "Other service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is agreed in a call (a delivery, an appointment), the summary has an "add to calendar" link.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to agree on a time, the AI does not agree right away but says it will check and get back to it. Then press Accept or Reject under "Things to take care of" on the Calls page, or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After your decision, the phone that answered the call sends the caller a text message (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: a text message to a mobile phone, an AI callback to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (abroad, toll-free numbers and similar) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models that have "thinking" in their name. Low answers fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, enable USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the "Allow USB debugging?" query.

console.ph_offline.back: No connection: unplug the cable and connect it again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app has not been installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection works and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection has not been established yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off.back: The USB helper function is off

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones connected by USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.usb_none.back: No phone was found on USB

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add your key so that the AI can speak.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI what callers call you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions under "Information about you" so that the AI sounds more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected right now. See "Phones" on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a channel to get the call summaries to your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: Needs a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Try it by calling your phone's number.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone reconnected during the call

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller hung up while leaving a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: The caller does not want a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer to the question about the way to reply

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer to repeating the contact details

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: The caller said the contact details were wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_contact_confirmed.back: The caller confirmed the contact details

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked for a callback

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: AI sent no sound, moved to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI's sound could not be played, moved to voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: Came in during another call, rejected as busy

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: Recording or voice menu: call ended

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This text message cannot be sent again: the appointment has not been decided yet, or the message has already gone out.

console.err_no_calendar.back: This call has no calendar suggestion.

console.err_no_audio.back: This call has no recording of this kind.

console.err_open_failed.back: The recording could not be opened.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background sound is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The sound file of this background sound is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: The audio sample could not be created. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: The settings could not be written to the disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: The task could not be performed.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not recognize this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: The field "{field}" has to begin with http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the Token or password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not recognize this address or Token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service replied with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use an unencrypted room.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo does not send to this address. Give the notification service's own address.

console.err_network_error.back: The service could not be reached.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the console at the address http://name.local. Only letters, digits and hyphens. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Read the code with the phone's camera to open the console on it.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the console's address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to the home screen. Next time just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome's menu ⋮ → Add to home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon on the right edge of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some older Android phones) use:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app of this phone to change the mode from here

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: The AI will no longer answer calls coming to this phone. It rings like a normal phone and someone has to answer it themselves. You can switch back any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: It is now a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: switch after it ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in a call. Try again after it ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still finishing the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module is not running on the phone. Check in Magisk or KernelSU that Bageo Uplink is enabled, and restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not change the default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the call screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change the Do Not Disturb mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not put the ringtone back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the phone's app is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed yet. Refresh the page after a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: something went wrong on the phone

console.er_new_d.back: The AI calls, takes care of the matter and tells you how it went. During the call you can follow the text and advise the AI at any time.

console.er_to_ph.back: Find a contact by typing a name or give a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No contact was found with this name. You can also type the number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact from the list or type a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back: e.g. Reserve a table for 4 people tomorrow at 19 under the name Laine, non-smoking; if 19 is full, 19.30–20 is fine too; or: Ask which day this weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: Tell what you want taken care of and what suits you. If the AI is unsure during the call, it asks you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf as your assistant.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line from which this number can be called)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone that is in normal phone mode cannot make AI calls. Switch it back to AI answering on the System page.

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so that the AI does not have to interrupt and ask during the call.

console.er_started.back: Given to the AI. It is calling now.

console.er_queued.back: In the queue. The AI calls as soon as a phone becomes free.

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs to be taken care of. The AI calls, takes care of the matter and tells you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody answers or the line is busy, it calls again at one-minute intervals, at most 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Call again until answered: attempt {n} got no answer, calling again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Calling, waiting for them to answer…

console.er_watching.back: You are following the call: in uncertain situations the AI asks you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time ran out, the AI decides by itself

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Say that 20:00 is fine too

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI ends the call immediately. The matter may be left unfinished.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: The other party did not confirm

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not present, no answer

console.er_options.back: Their options. Choose one and the AI calls back and tells them it:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and ask the AI to call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI calls {who} again and replies with this.

console.er_delete_b.back: It disappears from this list. The call information remains.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: The number does not look right.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or service number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: None of the phones has a SIM card that can call the numbers of this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not answered a call yet, so the system does not know its SIM cards. Call it once and then try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI has to take care of.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: The text is too long: at most 1,000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is available right now (not connected or all are in normal phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This errand call or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still in the queue or ongoing. Try again after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI cannot pass this on.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Who the AI says it is when it calls on your behalf. A different one can still be chosen for each errand call separately.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: Whitelist (family and friends; can be connected to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Stalling list (the AI wastes their time from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls coming from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you and when. This does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: redirect to your own phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers and connects to you if the matter is urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone calls when a matter is urgent.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: When set, the console asks for it when opened (once per browser). Needed to open the console with a phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you open this console from outside your home network. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. It is asked again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must have at least 8 characters.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: On a server channel, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message you can leave this empty. Your own ID: enable Developer Mode, right-click your name → Copy user ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: On a channel, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message you can leave this empty. Your member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room that has others, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. A room with only you and the bot can stay empty. A Matrix ID looks like this: @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check calls, ask the AI to call, and take care of tasks straight from this chat. Send "@yourbot /help" to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check calls, ask the AI to call, and take care of tasks straight from this chat. Send "@yourbot /help" to see the commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent: you could not be reached

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI left while calling you

console.urg_why_ended.back: the call to you was cut

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone was not able to call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: The text is too long. Shorten it.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: The question has already been answered or the time ran out.

console.d_del_call_b.back: Its summary, transcript and recording are deleted permanently.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All ended calls and their recordings are deleted permanently. Ongoing calls remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait for the call to end before deleting it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this phone, which has no connection, from the list. Earlier call information remains.

console.err_device_online.back: Disconnect this phone first before deleting it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait for the call on this phone to end.

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choose the voice of the announcement

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only numbers on the blacklist can end with the * character, and at least 3 digits must precede it excluding leading zeros.

console.sms_search_ph.back: Search for a sender or text

console.sms_empty_d.back: The text messages your phones receive appear here when the text message forwarding is running.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation or press "New message".

console.wl_call_terms_5.back: The call to you may not necessarily get through. You use the feature at your own risk; Bageo and its developers are not responsible for any damages.
